summary: This note is a short wiki-style biography of Prince Khosrow Mirza (1811–1883), a Persian prince of the Qajar Dynasty identified as the seventh son of Abbas Mirza and brother of Djahangir Mirza. It also notes his appearance in Alexander Sokurov's 2002 film Russian Ark, which depicts him in a young form and portrays an elaborate ceremonial apology before the Russian Tsar.
one_line: Khosrow Mirza (1811–1883) was a Qajar prince, son of Abbas Mirza, who appears in Sokurov's 2002 film Russian Ark.
key_facts: Prince Khosrow Mirza lived from 1811 to 1883.
Khosrow Mirza was a Persian Prince of the Qajar Dynasty.
Khosrow Mirza was the 7th son of Abbas Mirza.
Khosrow Mirza was the brother of Djahangir Mirza.
A young Khosrow Mirza is briefly depicted in Alexander Sokurov's 2002 film Russian Ark.
Russian Ark was directed by Alexander Sokurov and released in 2002.
Russian Ark portrays Khosrow Mirza's elaborate ceremonial apology before the Russian Tsar.
